items.title: Bowen: As long as West Ham get back to the PL, I don't care how we do it
items.description: When West Ham were relegated from the Premier League after 15 years back in May, it seemed inevitable Jarrod Bowen would not be there to join them as they returned to the Sky Bet Championship.

items.title: Tempers flare as Australia toil after Hasan's maiden Test ton
items.description: Tanzid Hasan posted his maiden century in just his second Test to help guide Bangladesh to 351-6 at stumps on Friday and into a commanding position over Australia after two days of the Top End series opener in Darwin.
